full_text:
Publishing 3 times a day on LinkedIn will trigger shadowbans.

Over-posting degrades algorithmic reach per post by up to 55%.

We configured APScheduler to enforce a strict 1 post/day limit at peak engagement time (9:30 AM IST).

Quality and consistent pacing outperform raw volume every single time.

What posting frequency has yielded the best organic engagement for your account?
